# Sun Robotics & AI

> Sun Robotics & AI is an industrial robotics, AI automation, and enterprise IT
> solutions company based in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India.

Sun Robotics & AI designs and builds industrial robotic arms, AI-driven
automation systems, and multipurpose robotics platforms for manufacturing,
logistics, and quality-control use cases. Alongside its robotics products
(the SunBot line), the company runs an IT Solutions practice offering custom
website development, app development, enterprise APIs, cloud/IoT integration,
and AI-powered dashboards for businesses in Indore and across India.

## Company

- [Homepage](https://sunroboticsandai.in/): Overview of AI & robotics + IT solutions offerings.
- [About](https://sunroboticsandai.in/about): Company mission, values, and team.
- [Contact](https://sunroboticsandai.in/contact): Address, phone, email, and contact form.
- [Careers](https://sunroboticsandai.in/careers): Open positions.

## Robotics & AI

- [Robotics](https://sunroboticsandai.in/robotics): Industrial robotic arms, AI automation, and multipurpose robotics platforms.
- [Products](https://sunroboticsandai.in/products): The SunBot product line — industrial arms, autonomous logistics robots, AI vision inspection, and collaborative robots.

## Sun IT Services

- [Sun IT Services](https://sunroboticsandai.in/sunitservices): Indore's leading IT services and custom software company. Specializes in custom website development (React, Next.js), mobile app development (iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter), enterprise backend APIs, cloud hosting (AWS), AI automation dashboards, and IoT system integration.
